title: Strict Hierarchy Refactoring mono repo root
description: The id system should be changed. From now on all bundles MUST have a parent project and all folders MUST have a parent bundle and all files MUST have a parent folder. Introduce virtual 🥇mono project and 🪆repo bundle. Files and folders on the root level are children of 🪆repo bundle. Every bundle has a virtual folder called 🌱root that is the parent of all files that are on the root folder level of the bundle.
